dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The 3-5 most prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures feature irregular, jagged perimeters with a rapid gradient transition from low-intensity dark centers to high-intensity light silver-gray edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of low-intensity dark pixel blobs across the lateral surface, characterized by consistent low-value core concentrations and minimal internal gradient variation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the most posterior centroid located ventrally relative to the two anterior-most centroids.
